svg.title: Ramp the substrate from approximately 250 °C to 390 °C
svg.desc: Load into the Riber C-21 CBE system and ramp under TBP. Ramp duration and rate are unreported. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Substrate temperature is measured by pyrometer and cross-checked with the manipulator thermocouple; overall accuracy is ±10 °C. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.
